description: VN→ZH classifier over-generalization: Vietnamese learners default to 个 for every noun, but Mandarin assigns a specific classifier per noun. Rule zh-ge-overgeneralization rewrites 个 → the correct classifier for a closed noun map (书→本, 狗/猫/鸟→只, 马→匹).
fp_risk_note: Low risk. Rewrites 个 → the correct classifier only for a closed noun map (书→本; 狗/猫/鸟→只; 马→匹) after a number/demonstrative. Compounds where the char is not the counted head (书店/书法/书架, 马路/马桶) are guarded by tail lookaheads; nouns that genuinely take 个 (人, 苹果, 学生) are not in the map and abstain.

positive.notes: 一个书 → 一本书 (书 takes 本, not 个).
一个狗 → 一只狗 (animal classifier 只).
那个猫 → 那只猫 (demonstrative + animal classifier 只).

negative.notes: 人 genuinely takes 个 — not in the map, must abstain.
苹果 genuinely takes 个 — not in the map, must abstain.
书店 (bookstore) — 书 is not the counted head; the 店 tail lookahead blocks it, must abstain.
